answer:
关于“多跳”：2WikiMultiHop 被用作多跳评测数据集，原文在结果讨论中直接写“2WikiMultiHop”，但没有进一步定义“多跳”任务关系；可确认的是它作为含多跳问题的数据集被使用 [chunk_406249e1d98db3baa838606c7a974998]，且实验在 2WikiMultiHop 与 QALD-10 上以 Wikidata 为知识图谱 [chunk_bc1cd12431f46892d2877dff73dab5e5]。

关于“交并逻辑”：所提供的原文证据未出现“交并逻辑”或等价描述；证据中 Tree-of-Traversals 的文段只说明 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 需要“synthesizing information from multiple KGs”与“reasoning with information from both MusicBrainz and Wikidata” [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]，并未把该任务关系表述为交并逻辑，因此交并逻辑的流程证据不足。

关于“跨 KG”：Tree-of-Traversals 明确把 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 描述为跨多个知识图谱综合与推理的新用例，并说明该数据集“require reasoning with information from both MusicBrainz and Wikidata” [chunk_f4962498025654850621ee329d0af7d6]；实现上说明 MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata 在 Wikidata 之外还使用 MusicBrainz [chunk_bc1cd12431f46892d2877dff73dab5e5]。这是证据可直接支持的跨 KG 绑定。

LPKG 的 CLQA-Wiki：提供的证据中没有 LPKG 或 CLQA-Wiki 的描述，无法把“多跳”“交并逻辑”“跨 KG”逐项绑定到 CLQA-Wiki；这是证据缺口。

citations.source_relative_path: Methods/018_Tree-of-Traversals A Zero-Shot Reasoning Algorithm for Augmenting Black-box Language Model.pdf
citations.quote:
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata Dataset One novel
use-case of Tree-of-Traversals is synthesizing and
reasoning over multiple knowledge graph sources.
There is no existing dataset that requires synthesiz-
ing information from multiple KGs to answer indi-
vidual questions. Therefore, to test the reasoning
ability using multiple KGs, we create a new dataset,
MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata, containing 109 questions
that require reasoning with information from both
MusicBrainz and Wikidata. Unlike Wikidata which
contains general knowledge, MusicBrainz is a deep
domain-specific database on the music industry.
The vast majority of this information is unlikely to
be known by large language models. We construct
the MusicBrainz-x-Wikidata dataset with human
annotators who were provided with instructions
to find reasoning paths between these two KGs,
the question types to focus on, and some example
questions.
